entries.title: Use the available width for project and group navigation
entries.description: Remove legacy width reservations that forced fixed project and group tabs to scroll despite available header space. Keep all navigation labels visible by wrapping in narrow windows, and wrap project settings and file-view controls within their pane. Preserve scrolling and keyboard navigation for an open-ended list of workspace tabs.

entries.title: Use the same Ops assistant across app screens
entries.description: Keep a resizable right-hand conversation while moving through Home, groups and projects. Explicitly select its work target, update project names and descriptions with revision checks, retain drafts and use typed review, reply, document and navigation tools bound to the request’s original project and review generation. Read stored completion evidence and exact goal responses before replying to the original review.

entries.title: Manage versioned skills and deliver their resources to Ops
entries.description: Inspect skills initialized from the verified original provided ZIPs, import ZIP packages, author and edit Markdown, manage task assignment, enable or remove packages and preserve resources through updates and backups. Goal and management requests retain an immutable skill version and expose its text and resources through typed runtime tools. Report-tool availability is shown separately from ordinary review work.

entries.title: Manage ReviewOps in a persistent Codex conversation
entries.description: Create projects and goals, update schedules and explicitly start or finish work through typed app tools. Keep management conversations separate from each goal, retain previous conversations and the original position of replayed messages and open the related project or goal from a confirmed result.

entries.title: Connect to a work PC from a browser or another ReviewOps app
entries.description: Enable browser viewing and app access separately in Remote management. Approve project-scoped devices, inspect reviews and attachments, and run or stop Codex in the work PC's configured local or SSH environment. Both listeners start disabled.

entries.title: Use compact goal rows and Markdown goal prompts
entries.description: Switch between Conversation and Goals, inspect goal details in four tabs and use one state-appropriate Start or Finish action. Search project and model choices, edit Markdown locally in Monaco and restart a finished goal with its original conversation. New and retained goals use full local access without interactive approvals.

entries.title: Keep page titles and controls consistent
entries.description: Use shared headers across Home, Ops, Groups, accounts, hosts and settings. Align titles with actions and search, retain useful paths inline and keep long project navigation clear in narrow windows and either sidebar state. Keep static manager titles readable before optional paths when narrow windows share space with several actions.

entries.title: Preserve remote edit intent through conflicts and disconnections
entries.description: Bind writes to the original project birth, review generation and revision. Compare a stale draft before explicit rebasing, retain pending requests after a lost reply, retrieve their original result without replaying mutations and show refresh or disconnected state.

entries.title: Preserve protected remote profiles when key access is refused
entries.description: Keep the original identity and sealed connections, report the operating-system refusal and retry only the existing protected reference. This does not grant an updated ad hoc app access to an older app's Keychain item; explicit OS authorization or a separately qualified identity migration remains required.

entries.title: Use the model catalog from the selected goal runtime
entries.description: Use a project's custom local executable for both its model list and actual goal session. Reject changed targets during resolution, refresh a cold catalog when metadata arrives and clear false conflict warnings after a confirmed own save.

entries.title: Keep expanded execution logs readable during long responses
entries.description: Bound the response area while progress is expanded, preserve the existing log reading position as output grows and support independent keyboard scrolling. An explicit jump to latest moves both the response and progress; closing progress restores the complete response.
